title: Culling frustum passes the field of view in degrees to tan(); the projection converts it to radians
expect_note: no existing diagnostic code covers an angle unit mismatch in host code (round 3: new code meaning.unit-mismatch added after the held-out run; original label kept in heldout_label)
expected_finding: Frustum::Frustum computes tan(m_Fov * 0.5) with m_Fov in degrees, while getProjection uses glm::radians(m_Fov): the culling cone and the rendered cone disagree, so visible chunks are dropped from the instance buffer
